market_summary: USD and market liquidity shifts during London/NY Overlap show strong risk-off and heavy selling across Gold and Crypto, both trading well below their session Value Areas and VWAP baselines with bearish CVD confirmation. GBPUSD remains compressed mid-range near session VWAP. US100 experienced a violent intrabar mean-reversion squeeze approaching Gamma Flip resistance, prompting a hold to avoid chasing extended momentum.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3943.91) and below POC (3978.00) in negative territory. CVD is -7.82 with BEARISH label and negative slope (-0.89), agreeing with downward momentum. Current session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains firmly below VWAP (3957.06) and EMA50 (3948.65), testing the lower ATR band (3903.71) with multiple preceding RVOL > 2.0 yellow spikes confirming distribution. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3948.87), favoring continuation toward Put Wall #1 at 3871.55. Forming bar bounced slightly off Session Low (3882.79) offering a pullback entry to rejoin the trend.

signals.rationale: Signal bar closed below VAL (28081.85) and POC (28120.74), but live forming M15 bar has staged a massive expansion breakout above VAH (28194.99), VWAP (28116.11), and EMA50 (28118.73) to 28226.01.
